description: Author E-E-A-T: attribute article authorship to a real named Person (not the Organization) in Article JSON-LD, add dedicated author bio pages at /news/author/[slug] with Person schema, link the article byline/bio to them, and extend the Author data model with optional credential fields. This is the core YMYL trust improvement. Depends on FEAT-001 (green baseline).
steps: Extend the Author model for E-E-A-T. In lib/sanity-queries.ts add optional fields to the `Author` interface: `jobTitle?: string`, `credentials?: string` (e.g. 'CFA, MBA' or a short qualification line), and `sameAs?: string[]` (author's own professional profile URLs, e.g. LinkedIn/personal site). Add these same fields to the `articleFullFields` GROQ author projection (author->{ _id, name, slug, bio, jobTitle, credentials, sameAs, "imageUrl": image.asset->url }). Leave articleCardFields (card author) unchanged.

Add matching optional fields to the Sanity author document in sanity/schemas/author.ts: a `jobTitle` string field, a `credentials` string field (title 'Credentials', description explaining it is used for E-E-A-T), and a `sameAs` array-of-url field (title 'Profile links / sameAs'). Keep them optional (no Rule.required) so existing content still validates.

Populate credential data on the sample authors in data/sample-news.ts: give each entry in `sampleAuthors` a realistic `jobTitle` derived from its existing bio (e.g. michael-torres -> 'Senior Cryptocurrency Correspondent', sarah-chen -> 'Federal Reserve & Monetary Policy Writer', robert-feldman -> 'Regulation Editor', jennifer-walsh -> 'Housing & Mortgage Reporter', etc.) Do NOT invent external social/profile URLs for the sample authors (leave sameAs undefined) and do NOT fabricate certifications not implied by the existing bio text. jobTitle is a factual role description, which is safe; credentials/sameAs stay empty for samples unless clearly implied by the existing bio (e.g. Sarah Chen 'former research economist at the Federal Reserve Bank of New York' can have credentials describing that).

Change generateArticleSchema in lib/schema-markup.ts to accept a structured author instead of a bare string. Update the param type to `author?: { name: string; url?: string; jobTitle?: string; sameAs?: string[]; image?: string }`. When an author object with a name is provided, emit `author` as `{ '@type': 'Person', name, ...(url && { url }), ...(jobTitle && { jobTitle }), ...(image && { image }), ...(sameAs?.length && { sameAs }) }`. When no author is provided, fall back to the current `{ '@type': 'Organization', name: siteConfig.name }`. Keep `publisher` as the Organization exactly as-is. Do not remove the existing dateModified/image/mainEntityOfPage behavior.

Update the caller in app/(site)/news/[slug]/page.tsx: build the author argument from the full `article.author` object, not just its name. Pass name, `url` = `${siteConfig.url}/news/author/${article.author.slug.current}` (only when a slug exists), jobTitle, sameAs, and image = article.author.imageUrl. Keep the schema fallback safe if article.author is undefined.

Create the author bio page route app/(site)/news/author/[slug]/page.tsx. It must: (a) add a helper to resolve an author by slug and list that author's articles from the same data source the site renders. Prefer adding a small helper such as `getAuthorBySlug(slug)` and `getArticlesByAuthor(slug)` in lib/sanity-queries.ts that use Sanity when configured (GROQ: author document by slug, and articles where author->slug.current == $slug) and fall back to data/sample-news.ts (sampleAuthors + sampleArticles filtered by author) when Sanity is empty - mirror the existing hasSanityArticles fallback pattern already in that file. Also export a sample-side helper from data/sample-news.ts if needed (e.g. getSampleAuthorBySlug, getSampleArticlesByAuthor). (b) implement generateStaticParams from the sample authors so every known author page pre-renders (dynamicParams may stay true for CMS-added authors). (c) render the author name, jobTitle/credentials, avatar, bio, their sameAs links (if any), and a grid of their articles reusing components/news/ArticleCard.tsx and the existing page layout utilities (container-page, section-padding, page-title, Reveal). (d) provide generateMetadata (title/description/canonical /news/author/<slug>) and emit Person + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD via <script type=application/ld+json> (Person: name, url=canonical, jobTitle, image, sameAs, description=bio, worksFor=Organization). Call notFound() for unknown slugs.

Link to the new author page from the article: in app/(site)/news/[slug]/page.tsx, make the author name in the existing 'Written by' bio <aside> (and, if trivially done in components/news/Byline.tsx, the byline name) link to /news/author/<slug>. Keep this change minimal; do not restyle the byline.
acceptance_criteria: generateArticleSchema emits `author` with `@type: 'Person'` (name + url + jobTitle when available) when an author is passed, and falls back to Organization only when no author is provided; publisher remains Organization
Visiting /news/<any-sample-slug> yields Article JSON-LD whose author is a Person with a url pointing at /news/author/<author-slug>
/news/author/<author-slug> renders for every sample author (e.g. /news/author/michael-torres), showing bio, jobTitle, and that author's articles, and emits Person JSON-LD; an unknown author slug 404s
The Author interface and Sanity author schema both carry optional jobTitle/credentials/sameAs; articleFullFields GROQ selects them
No fabricated external profile URLs or unsupported certifications were added to sample authors
`unset NODE_OPTIONS && npm run lint` and `unset NODE_OPTIONS && npm run build` both pass
verification: Grep the built .next output or run the page to confirm Person author schema; manually confirm /news/author/michael-torres builds (appears in build route list) and an unknown slug is handled by notFound
findings:
Implemented author E-E-A-T end to end. Per file:
- lib/sanity-queries.ts: Added optional jobTitle/credentials/sameAs to the Author interface; added them (plus sameAs, credentials) to the articleFullFields author-> projection (articleCardFields left unchanged). Added an authorFields GROQ projection and two cached-pattern fetch helpers getAuthorBySlug(slug) and getArticlesByAuthor(slug) that use Sanity when hasSanityArticles() is true and fall back to new sample helpers otherwise. Imported getSampleAuthorBySlug/getSampleArticlesByAuthor.
- data/sample-news.ts: Added factual jobTitle to all 10 sampleAuthors derived from their bios; added credentials only where clearly implied by existing bio text (sarah-chen: former Fed NY research economist; jennifer-walsh: MIT urban economics degree; robert-feldman: former securities attorney). Did NOT add sameAs or fabricate certifications/URLs. Added getSampleAuthors(), getSampleAuthorBySlug(slug), getSampleArticlesByAuthor(slug) plus a cardIdsByAuthorSlug index derived from orderedSeeds.
- sanity/schemas/author.ts: Added optional jobTitle (string), credentials (string, E-E-A-T description), and sameAs (array of url, title 'Profile links / sameAs') fields; all optional, placed before image.
- lib/schema-markup.ts: generateArticleSchema author param changed from `string` to `{ name; url?; jobTitle?; sameAs?; image? }`. Emits author as @type Person (name + optional url/jobTitle/image/sameAs) when a named author is provided, else falls back to Organization. Publisher/dateModified/image/mainEntityOfPage unchanged.
- app/(site)/news/[slug]/page.tsx: Caller now builds the structured author object (name, url=<siteUrl>/news/author/<slug> when slug exists, jobTitle, sameAs, image=imageUrl) with a safe undefined fallback. The 'Written by' bio aside now links the author name to /news/author/<slug> and shows jobTitle.
- app/(site)/news/author/[slug]/page.tsx (new): generateStaticParams from sample authors (dynamicParams default true), generateMetadata with canonical /news/author/<slug>, Person + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, notFound() for unknown slugs, and renders name/jobTitle/credentials/avatar/bio/sameAs links plus the author's article grid reusing ArticleCard and layout utilities (container-page, section-padding, page-title, panel, section-header, rule-grid, Reveal).

VERIFICATION NOT RUNNABLE: node_modules is missing the `next` and `typescript` binaries and the npm registry returns HTTP 403 in this sandbox, so `npm install`, `npm run build`, `npm run lint`, and `tsc --noEmit` cannot run. Validated by static review: all imported/exported symbol names checked, TypeScript shapes verified against Author/Article/ArticleCard interfaces and sampleAuthors, layout utility classes confirmed present in app/globals.css, and the sole generateArticleSchema caller updated to the new signature. The `...(cond && { ... })` conditional-spread pattern matches existing usage in the same page. Scope limited to author E-E-A-T; sitemap and social-handle items (FEAT-003) untouched. Build/lint could not be confirmed green in-sandbox.
